family: Network flow, packet, segmentation, IDS, and anomaly assurance

selection.reason: These ten skills share bounded flow/packet/event schemas, segmentation policy, IDS rule manifests, and anomaly metadata. Static predicates are proposed only where deterministic; NetFlow, Scapy, Wireshark, Suricata, Zeek, IDS/IPS, packet capture, and network runtime authorities remain blocked external engines. Procedure and judgment remain advisory/manual. The batch is exactly ten, disjoint from CP08 batches 01-12, and excludes the protected sourceUnavailable identity.

components.predicateOrPurpose: Flag malformed flow identity/timestamps, impossible durations, denied/unknown routes, and configured volume or destination thresholds.

components.positiveBoundary: A fixture crossing a declared flow threshold produces a finding.
components.negativeBoundary: Valid, below-threshold flow records remain clean.
evidenceRefs: source:# Analyzing Network Flow Data with Netflow:L31
